Verify the Open tab is shown.
Verify the In Progress tab is shown.
Verify the Completed tab is shown.
Verify the Rejected tab is shown.
Verify the Deleted tab is shown.
Check that the PR table has rows and that each row exposes the requested identifying and descriptive fields.
Confirm there is no blank page, server error, crash, or raw broken content.
